result_semantics: The complete 2021-2023 support is already consumed exploration data. A pass is TIER1_EXPLORATION_PASS only and cannot authorize Tier 2, Formal, Strategy, Dry-run, Live, credentials, accounts, or orders.

forbidden_fields: current exchangeInfo or current survivor universe
data_contract.holdout_semantics: No untouched holdout is used. 2021, 2022, and 2023 are one consumed Tier-1 exploration window; calendar-year slices are diagnostics only.
data_contract.ohlc_loader_extension: Before Candidate 1 performance, the existing Price V1 loader must parse high and low from the same manifest-bound curated kline rows. Validate finite positive OHLC, high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), and high >= low. This is a field exposure only; snapshot identity, files, cohort, PIT, and lifecycle remain unchanged.
data_contract.membership_rule: At completed decision close t, compute signals only for canonical universe_at(t) members with every frozen required input. At execution open t+1, a canonical lifecycle removal cancels that target into cash without reranking or renormalizing survivors. Any other missing execution open is DATA_ERROR_STOP.
data_contract.lifecycle_rule: Never infer a terminal from missing price. Retain a held instrument through its canonical terminal day's open-to-final-close interval, liquidate exactly once at the canonical terminal timestamp, charge exit costs, and leave all later close and valuation cells unavailable without forward fill.
data_contract.missingness_rule: Malformed identity, PIT, lifecycle, price, volume, schedule, decision input, unexplained missing bar, or incomplete horizon is DATA_ERROR_STOP. No imputation, current-universe substitution, silent cohort shrinkage, or partial horizon is allowed.

common_execution_and_evaluation.decision_timestamp: All signal inputs are completed by UTC daily close t.
common_execution_and_evaluation.execution_timestamp: Target-percent orders execute no earlier than the next UTC daily open t+1.
common_execution_and_evaluation.position_construction: Rank the full decision-eligible set ascending with canonical-symbol tie-break; long the highest 20 percent and short the lowest 20 percent, floor one name per leg, equal-weight 0.50 gross per leg, total gross 1.00 and target net 0.00. Require at least 20 eligible names.
common_execution_and_evaluation.ties: Average ranks are used for predictive rank IC. Portfolio leg membership uses ascending signal then canonical symbol, including deterministic canonical-symbol resolution at a leg boundary.
common_execution_and_evaluation.execution_cancellation: A name canonically unavailable at t+1 is set to zero and its frozen target remains cash; no execution-time reranking or renormalization is permitted.
common_execution_and_evaluation.portfolio_path: One continuous vectorbt portfolio per specification. Rebalances set explicit target percentages; terminal rows and final exit set explicit zero targets. ffill_val_price=false and fillna_close=false.
common_execution_and_evaluation.gross_result: vectorbt run with fee_rate=0 and one_side_slippage=0
common_execution_and_evaluation.net_result: vectorbt run with the frozen base cost
common_execution_and_evaluation.cost_stress: vectorbt run with the frozen 30 bps one-way stress cost
common_execution_and_evaluation.predictive_statistic: Mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC between decision signal and the instrument return from execution open through the next scheduled execution open, or canonical terminal close when earlier; lag-3 Newey-West one-sided normal p-value.
common_execution_and_evaluation.turnover: At each scheduled execution or terminal/final exit, sum absolute target-percent change versus the drifted incumbent immediately before the order row; report the median across scheduled rebalances.
common_execution_and_evaluation.concentration: After the explicit final exit, sum vectorbt closed-trade net PnL by symbol. Top contributor share is max absolute symbol PnL divided by sum absolute symbol PnL; zero denominator fails.
common_execution_and_evaluation.single_symbol_sensitivity: Identify the symbol with the largest strictly positive stress net PnL, set only that symbol's targets to zero for all rows without reweighting, rerun the frozen stress portfolio, and require a positive mean daily return.
common_execution_and_evaluation.subperiod_rule: Compute compounded stress returns in calendar 2021, 2022, and 2023 from the same continuous path without resetting or liquidating at year boundaries; at least two must be nonnegative.
common_execution_and_evaluation.independent_observation_rule: At least 100 scheduled, non-overlapping rebalance observations are required.
common_execution_and_evaluation.sequential_stop: Run Candidate 1 first. If it passes every frozen gate, stop and do not run Candidate 2. Run Candidate 2 only after Candidate 1 is recorded TIER1_FAIL in research/process/vbt-alpha-program-001-program-history.json and research/exploration/factor-graveyard.md, and that history-only transition is committed before Candidate 2 performance. Stop after Candidate 2 regardless of outcome.
common_execution_and_evaluation.post_result_prohibitions: Do not change direction, lookback, threshold, holding period, rebalance, universe, costs, success criteria, filters, symbols, or variants after any performance is exposed.

pre_performance_simulator_preflight.contract: Use synthetic prices and targets only. Verify vectorbt target-percent long and short orders, total gross 1.00 and target net 0.00, completed-close valuation with next-open order price, fee and one-side slippage on both long and short transactions, explicit terminal zero target, no post-terminal close/valuation fill, and deterministic replay. The artifact must contain no return, PnL, Sharpe, drawdown, IC, or candidate signal value.
pre_performance_simulator_preflight.gate: Checkpoint A cannot pass and no candidate performance may run until this metric-free preflight is PASS.

pass_fail_criteria.stress_mean_daily_positive: 30 bps stress arithmetic mean daily return > 0
pass_fail_criteria.predictive_direction: mean rank IC > 0 and lag-3 HAC one-sided normal p <= 0.05
pass_fail_criteria.turnover: median one-way turnover per scheduled rebalance <= 1.25
pass_fail_criteria.single_symbol_sensitivity: largest strictly positive contributor removal retains positive 30 bps stress mean daily return
pass_fail_criteria.subperiods: at least two of 2021, 2022, and 2023 stress diagnostic total returns are >= 0
pass_fail_criteria.sanity_neighbor: the single frozen neighbor has positive 30 bps stress total return, positive stress mean daily return, and positive mean rank IC
pass_fail_criteria.observations: at least 100 non-overlapping scheduled rebalance observations
pass_fail_criteria.data_and_lifecycle: all identity, PIT, timing, missingness, cost, deterministic replay, and lifecycle checks pass
pass_fail_criteria.overall: TIER1_PASS only if every criterion passes; otherwise TIER1_FAIL

generated_candidate_pool.screening_rationale: Close location within a completed intraday range, amplified only by an own-history volume surprise, tests directional price acceptance rather than the failed cross-sectional volume-share migration or a momentum lookback.
Relative synchrony with the equal-weight cohort is a crowding/participation characteristic rather than return momentum, volatility level, idiosyncratic shock reversal, or volume-share migration.
A dispersion state applied to directional returns risks restating EXPL-017's closed momentum-by-state mechanism and is excluded before preregistration.

candidates.rationale: A close near one end of a completed daily range on unusually high own quote volume can represent accepted directional price discovery rather than a transient mark or a change in cross-sectional activity share. The expected relation is continuation over the fixed short horizon.
candidates.signal_formula: At completed decision t, CLV_i,t=(2*close_i,t-high_i,t-low_i,t)/(high_i,t-low_i,t). volume_surprise_i,t=log(quote_volume_i,t/median(quote_volume_i,t-20:t-1)). signal_i,t=CLV_i,t*volume_surprise_i,t. Higher signal predicts higher forward relative return.

sanity_neighbor.only_change: Use 30 completed prior quote-volume days excluding t for the median; all other fields are identical.

candidates.holding_period: 5 calendar days, execution open through the next scheduled UTC open five calendar days later or canonical terminal close when earlier
candidates.rebalance: Every 5 calendar days from 2021-02-08T00:00:00.000Z through 2023-11-05T00:00:00.000Z; explicit final exit at 2023-11-10T00:00:00.000Z. The later start gives the frozen 30-day neighbor all prior volumes strictly within supported completed daily rows.
candidates.universe: Full canonical universe_at(t) at the completed decision close, with every primary and neighbor input valid; canonical execution availability checked at t+1 only for cancellation into cash.
candidates.candidate_missingness: high must be strictly greater than low; open, high, low, close and execution open must be finite and positive; current and all required prior quote volumes must be finite and strictly positive. Any violation among canonical decision members is DATA_ERROR_STOP.
candidates.implementation_contract: Add high/low exposure to the existing frozen Price V1 Bar loader, implement one signal function, and feed target matrices through the existing vectorbt thin adapter; no new engine or portfolio abstraction.

candidates.rationale: Contracts whose recent returns are most synchronized with the equal-weight cohort can reflect crowded common positioning and greater exposure to cohort-wide deleveraging. Less synchronized names are expected to deliver higher subsequent relative returns than the most crowded names.
candidates.signal_formula: At completed decision t, freeze the canonical decision-eligible set. For lookback L, index k=0..L-1 and define r_i,k=close_i(t-k)/close_i(t-k-1)-1 using only completed closes t-L through t. For each k define m_k as the equal-weight mean of r_j,k across that identical frozen set. signal_i,t=-PearsonCorr((r_i,0..L-1),(m_0..L-1)). Higher signal means lower cohort synchrony and predicts higher forward relative return.

sanity_neighbor.only_change: Use 30 completed close-to-close returns; all other fields are identical.

candidates.holding_period: 7 calendar days, execution open through the next scheduled UTC open seven calendar days later or canonical terminal close when earlier
candidates.rebalance: Every 7 calendar days from 2021-02-08T00:00:00.000Z through 2023-11-06T00:00:00.000Z; explicit final exit at 2023-11-13T00:00:00.000Z
candidates.universe: Full canonical universe_at(t) at the completed decision close with 31 complete closes for both primary and neighbor, fixed identically across every correlation date; canonical execution availability checked at t+1 only for cancellation into cash.
candidates.candidate_missingness: Every frozen-set close and return must be finite, all prices positive, and both each symbol's return variance and cohort-market return variance strictly positive. Any violation is DATA_ERROR_STOP.
candidates.implementation_contract: Implement one correlation signal function and feed target matrices through the existing vectorbt thin adapter; no residual-momentum score, state gate, new engine, or portfolio abstraction.
